scripts.dev: rm -rf packages/frontend/dist && mkdir -p packages/frontend/dist && concurrently "pnpm --filter ./packages/shared build:watch" "pnpm --filter ./packages/api dev" "sleep 1 && pnpm --filter ./packages/frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter ./packages/shared build && pnpm --filter ./packages/api build && pnpm --filter ./packages/frontend build
